Cancer

Determination

Earth · Pentacles
SKY AT THIS READING
No planetary placement assigned

Application

FROM CARD TO CARD

The reading begins with Ace of Pentacles, reversed in Past · 18–24 Months and moves toward Page of Wands, reversed in Outcome · Next 18–24 Months.

Present Time · Two of Cups. Following Ace of Pentacles, Two of Cups may draw your attention toward mutuality.

These numbers are symbolic prompts, not guarantees. Notice whether any patterns resonate with numbers personally meaningful to you.

Take what resonates, and leave the rest.
